subject.title: fix(openai): reject malformed Codex image base64

question: Does the OpenAI extension intentionally need to match Codex's strict Base64 acceptance contract, including Unicode trimming and canonical trailing-bit rejection, rather than preserve Node's permissive decoder behavior?
rationale: The branch changes compatibility for malformed provider responses and repository policy requires direct Codex-source inspection before a Codex-related merge verdict; that inspection was unavailable here.

options.title: Confirm strict Codex parity
options.body: Accept malformed Codex image payloads as provider errors after a maintainer verifies the sibling Codex decoder contract.

options.title: Preserve permissive decoding
options.body: Keep Node-compatible tolerant decoding if malformed-but-decodable provider payloads are an intended compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm strict Codex parity
recommendation.body: Accept malformed Codex image payloads as provider errors after a maintainer verifies the sibling Codex decoder contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available evidence identifies this contributor as the only concrete participant with detailed decoder-contract research; current-main area ownership could not be traced.
